scope: two negative weight classes, nonuniform generated scores, no fitting
reference: Decimal60 full-PL survival DP over selected counts in two negative groups, group-logit sensitivities divided by group count
criterion: all six pairs: control full-gradient L2 error, negative MAE and negative maximum absolute error strictly lower than raw; control nonpositive negative-coordinate count no greater than raw; both arms pass schema/finiteness/shift-gradient-sum gates
risk_and_positive_errors: report all; stochastic errors have no invented deterministic accuracy threshold
failure_policy: retain all rows and full UID outputs; scientific criterion failure is recorded, no tuning, extra seeds, extra samples or retries
coverage_limit: six fixed cases, one seed per score condition and positive count; only three score classes, not arbitrary per-action nonuniformity
resource_policy: single local process; O(N+K) estimator working memory, O(K) live reference states; no retained trajectories/models; JSON cap 2MiB; no measured peak memory claim
